metaData.originalTitle: 刚刚，DeepSeek V4 新成果发布，推理速度更快了！
metaData.title: Just Now: DeepSeek V4 New Results Released, Inference Speed Gets Faster!
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: An in-depth interpretation of the DSpark speculative decoding framework jointly released by DeepSeek and Peking University, which replaces MTP-1 with semi-autoregressive drafts and dynamic scheduling, boosting V4's online generation speed by 60%–85%.
metaData.summary: This article systematically introduces the newly deployed speculative decoding framework DSpark for DeepSeek V4 and its accompanying training framework DeepSpec. It first reviews the pros and cons of two mainstream approaches to speculative decoding (autoregressive drafting and parallel drafting), then focuses on two core innovations of DSpark: 1) Semi-autoregressive draft: By adding a lightweight serial module (Markov head by default) after the parallel backbone, it solves the multimodal collision problem at the tail of parallel drafts with extremely low latency (0.2%–1.3%). Measured acceptance length improves by 26.7%–30.9% compared to Eagle3 and 16.3%–18.4% compared to DFlash. 2) Dynamic verification scheduling: Using a confidence head and STS calibration to obtain reliable survival probability, a hardware-aware scheduler dynamically determines verification length based on load, avoiding the waste of compute power on invalid verification under high concurrency. Production data show that, with throughput remaining flat, per-user generation speed improves by 60%–85% on V4-Flash and 57%–78% on V4-Pro. The article also points out limitations of DSpark — the fixed cost of drafting for complex requests persists — and suggests future directions. Overall, it is an in-depth interpretation with high information density, clear technical principles, and solid engineering deployment results.

mainPoints.point: DSpark balances parallel speed and autoregressive coherence through a semi-autoregressive draft model.
mainPoints.explanation: By adding a lightweight serial module (Markov head) after the parallel backbone, it compensates for sequential information between tokens with extremely low latency, eliminates multimodal collision at the tail of parallel drafts, and achieves acceptance lengths that comprehensively surpass existing solutions.

mainPoints.point: DSpark introduces dynamic verification scheduling, pruning invalid verification according to load.
mainPoints.explanation: Using a confidence head and STS calibration to obtain true survival probability, the hardware-aware scheduler automatically shortens verification length under high concurrency, allocating compute power to queued requests and avoiding the waste of fixed-length verification.

mainPoints.point: Online tests show 60%–85% generation speed improvement, reaching a new Pareto frontier in throughput and speed.
mainPoints.explanation: In production environments of V4-Flash and V4-Pro, DSpark significantly increases per-user generation speed while maintaining throughput; under strict latency requirements, it can leverage concurrency capacity by several orders of magnitude.

keyQuotes: In the two years of speculative decoding research, the focus has been on "how many drafts are written and how accurate they are," but DSpark turns its attention to another overlooked aspect: verification.

There is a vivid example of this drawback of parallel drafts: when the context simultaneously supports two continuations like 'of course' and 'no problem,' independent predictions may produce 'of problem' or 'no course'.
Under the premise of maintaining throughput, V4-Flash achieves a per-user generation speed increase of 60%–85%, and V4-Pro achieves 57%–78%.

relatedArticles.title: DeepSeek-V4 Preview: Ushering in the Era of Million-Token Context for Everyone

relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Based on the engineering delivery practices of an AI Team, this article proposes that knowledge accumulation is more important than workflow orchestration, and systematically introduces a complete methodology encompassing a five-layer knowledge storage architecture, a three-level maturity system, and how workflows serve knowledge accumulation.

relatedArticles.title: Kimi K2.6 Released and Open-Sourced, Significantly Advancing Code and Agent Cluster Capabilities

relatedArticles.title: Latest! A 10,000-Word Overview of the Harness Revolution!
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Based on the AI development context of 2026, this article systematically elaborates on Agent Harness as a strategic infrastructure for managing the complexity of agents. Starting from the evolution of software engineering history, it analyzes its core components and ecosystem landscape, and explores the direction of engineers' capability transformation in the Agent era.

relatedArticles.title: A Comprehensive Guide: The Evolution and Essence of Loop Engineering
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article traces the evolution from Prompt Engineering to Loop Engineering, explains the six-component principle using a cybernetic framework, and provides conditions for determining whether to build a Loop.

relatedArticles.title: Latest! A 10,000-Word Review: From Prompt to Loop Evolution
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically traces the evolution of AI development paradigms from Prompt Engineering to Loop Engineering, elaborating on the core concepts, tech stacks, and engineering practices of each stage, and proposing the role of the Loop Designer.

relatedArticles.title: Harness Engineering: How I Spent a Week Boosting AI Coding Rate to 90% in an Enterprise App
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically introduces Harness Engineering, a new AI coding paradigm that elevates the AI code rate of an enterprise Java application from 25% to over 90% by building a four-element system of rules, skills, knowledge, and change management.

relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides an in-depth analysis of the popular Silicon Valley concept of 'Harness Engineering,' proposing the formula 'Agent = Model + Harness,' and emphasizes unleashing AI productivity by building structured environments, feedback loops, and evaluation systems.

relatedArticles.title: Just In: The Most Comprehensive Agent Harness Overview Yet
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically reviews the concept of Agent Harness Engineering, its seven-layer framework (ETCLOVG), and engineering evolution, emphasizing that the engineering shell outside the model is key to moving Agents from demos to production.
